# Copper Scroll Column 11 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 11 (treasure locations 51-58) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 11:1 — pit of the ford / pit by the ford + beyond/past

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the pit of the ford which is beyond" |
| LOGOS | "the pit by the ford beyond" |
| PNEUMA | "the pit by the river crossing, past" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "the pit of the ford" preserving the Hebrew construct chain. PNEUMA's "river crossing" is interpretive.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 11:5-6 — under/beneath the wall + east side placement

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the cistern under the wall on the east side" |
| LOGOS | "the cistern beneath the wall on the eastern side" |
| PNEUMA | "the cistern under the east wall" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's word order "under the wall on the east side" — keeps the directional qualifier separate from the wall, matching the Hebrew.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 11:10 — at its entrance/mouth/just inside

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "at its entrance" — literal petach |
| LOGOS | "at its mouth" — pi |
| PNEUMA | "just inside the entrance" — interpretive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "at its entrance." PNEUMA's "just inside" adds spatial interpretation not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 11:12 — cedar and pine and resin phrasing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "vessels of offering of cedar and pine, and resin" |
| LOGOS | "offering vessels of cedar, pine, and resin" |
| PNEUMA | "offering vessels made of cedar and pine wood, plus resin" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's clean listing "offering vessels of cedar, pine, and resin" — natural English series while preserving all three materials.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 11:13-14 — pond/pool

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the pond near by" |
| LOGOS | "the nearby pool" |
| PNEUMA | "the nearby pond" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the pond nearby" — EMET's "pond" with adjusted placement. Bereikhah can mean pond or pool; "pond" is acceptable.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET (modified).

---

## 11:15-16 — total of the gold / sum total / total gold

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the total of the gold and vessels" |
| LOGOS | "the sum total of gold and vessels" |
| PNEUMA | "total gold and vessels combined" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "the total of the gold and vessels" as most literal.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 11: 6*
